description: Open-source, clean-room download manager written in Rust — downloads, videos and torrents
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { warn 'Browser integration was not registered, see notes.' }
notes: Browser integration is registered by this manifest for Chrome, Chromium, Edge, Brave and Firefox,
and removed again on uninstall. To finish the setup:
1. Load the extension from '$dir\extension\chromium' via chrome://extensions (Developer mode -> Load unpacked),
or install it from the browser's add-on store as 'Mister Download Manager'.
2. In the app enable Options -> General -> 'Use advanced browser integration' and tick the browsers to capture from.
Settings are kept in %APPDATA%\misterdownloadmanager. The portable zip is not used here: its 'data' folder
next to misterdownloadmanager.exe puts MDM in portable mode, which refuses to register browser integration.
